dct_description_sm: This GIS data (points .shp file) set contains 5806 point features that coincide with the centroid of each building location found on the Fire Insurance Plans (FIPS) of Edmonton for 1913. Each FIPS sheet was georeferenced and then the building data was collected. Attributes include  both the old address (pre-1913) and the new address, street names (old and new), block numbers, building materials (wood or brick), and the building heights.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available without information on how it can be used. You should communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
dct_title_s: Addresses, Material Type and Heights for City of Edmonton Buildings in 1913.
